interface.shortDescription: Search Chinese walled-garden platforms with TikHub.
interface.longDescription: A thin, read-only TikHub search layer for Xiaohongshu, Douyin, and WeChat Official Account articles. It discovers current MCP tools, applies platform-specific filters, and returns a consistent result list with source links. Selected results can optionally be expanded into public details or comments.
defaultPrompt: Search this topic on Xiaohongshu, Douyin, and WeChat Official Accounts.
Find the latest public discussion of this technology across all three platforms.
Search for these user pain points, then expand only the most relevant results.
